name: os-cordova-plugin-nos-widgets
description: Native home-screen widgets (Android Jetpack Glance / iOS WidgetKit) for OutSystems 11 mobile apps.
author: NOS
_comment_dependencies: The iOS after_prepare hook (hooks/ios-add-widget-extension.js) uses `xcode` to inject the WidgetKit extension target. MABS fetches this plugin from git and does NOT run `npm install` on plugin deps, so `xcode` + its dependency tree are VENDORED: committed under node_modules/ (see .gitignore) and declared in bundleDependencies. cordova-fetch copies node_modules into plugins/<id>/ on `cordova plugin add` (verified end-to-end), and the hook requires it from there — with cordova-ios's own bundled `xcode` as a fallback.
